title: Napheesa Collier on Jordan Brand, MJ & Kobe Inspiration, And Michael Jordan Joining NBC Sports
htmlContent:
Napheesa Collier, who was recently named a WNBA All-Star and plays for the Minnesota Lynx, is still making headlines on and off the field. Collier's career is being cemented as an elite athlete and a powerful voice in sports culture thanks to signing with the iconic Jordan Brand and stepping into a media role with NBC Sports. In an interview with Nick Hamilton of Nitecast Media, Collier discussed her latest venture with Jordan Brand, which directly ties her to one of the greatest basketball legacies ever. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lOagOyT-goI

What Would MJ Say?

Collier responded with humility when asked what Michael Jordan might say about her game:

"I just signed, so I hope he would be proud. I think it would be my footwork. I've modeled a lot of my game after MJ and Kobe [Bryant] because of their footwork. I admired them so much. So I hope he would be proud of that." Collier's appreciation for the fundamental art of footwork honors two of the most well-known players in basketball history. Both Michael Jordan and Kobe Bryant were known for their near-flawless precision on the court, an influence that resonates in Collier's smooth yet powerful playing style.

A New Chapter With NBC Sports

Collier is also making progress away from the hardwood. In a statement to LandonBuford.com, she expressed her support for Michael Jordan's transition into sports media as a special contributor with NBC Sports. "Excited for him. That's awesome," she said, echoing many's enthusiasm about seeing more athletes step into media roles. Her involvement with NBC Sports signals her expanding influence and provides a new platform to bring WNBA insights to a broader audience.

The Rise of Athlete-Driven Media

Jordan's presence in sports broadcasting evidences the growing trend of athletes taking over their own narratives and using their platforms to drive meaningful conversations. As a new member of the NBC Sports family, Jordan will provide expert analysis and personal insights and help bridge the gap between athletes and fans.

Why Napheesa Collier Is a Name to Watch

From her dominant performance on the court with the Minnesota Lynx to her partnership with Jordan and Napheesa Collier, she rapidly became an influential figure in the sports industry. Unrivaled is leading the way in women's sports' evolution. Collier demonstrates that achievement is not solely based on statistics—it's also dependent on legacy, leadership, and taking advantage of every opportunity.

A Bright Future Ahead

Napheesa Collier's continued success reflects the next generation of athletes, redefining what it means to be a sports icon. With her sights set on championships, cultural impact, and inspiring the next generation of hoopers, it's clear that she's only just getting started.
excerpt: WNBA star Napheesa Collier opens up about signing with Jordan Brand, modeling her game after Michael Jordan and Kobe Bryant, and her new role as a special contributor with NBC Sports. “I hope MJ would be proud,” she says, highlighting her footwork and growing influence on and off the court.
